high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation at the Reinforcement Learning Conference, as indicated by the logo in the top right corner. The slide is titled "How OaK creates a subproblem from a feature \(i, \kappa\)" and discusses concepts related to reinforcement learning. Slide Content: The slide explains how the OaK (Optimal Action-Knowledge) algorithm creates subproblems based on specific features. It defines: \(i =\) feature number \(\kappa =\) how intensely we want the feature, balanced against losing reward
